en.headline: Man, 46, found dead in a Yau Ma Tei room, police say
en.dek: Officers classified the Friday night case as the discovery of a body after a friend reported that the man had collapsed, Hong Kong 01 reported.
body: A 46-year-old man was found dead on Friday night in a room at Chak Hing Building, 589 Canton Road, Yau Ma Tei, according to Hong Kong 01.

The outlet reported that police received a call at about 8pm after a friend found the man had collapsed. Ambulance crews confirmed he was dead at the scene. Police classified the case as the discovery of a body. The cause of death is to be determined after a post-mortem examination.
Hong Kong 01 reported that the man was from India and was staying in Hong Kong on a recognisance form. No name was given. Police have not announced any arrest.

zh.headline: 油麻地46歲男子房間內暈倒 當場不治
zh.dek: 《香港01》報道，警方周五晚接報後將案件列作屍體發現，死因有待驗屍確定。
body: 《香港01》報道，油麻地廣東道589號澤興樓一間房間，周五晚有一名46歲男子暈倒，其後證實不治。
該報道指，約晚上8時，事主的朋友發現他暈倒後報案。救護員到場後證實他當場死亡。警方調查後將案件列作屍體發現，死因有待驗屍後確定。
《香港01》稱，事主來自印度，持行街紙留港。報道未有公布姓名，警方亦未宣布拘捕任何人。
